summary: Diagnosed the failed formal run: receipt ece1e96fdfc74eefadb2bd4c1c62b52b exited 1 before any test ran because the partial-restart harness used helpers declared in the sibling cluster-wide harness file, which is not copied into the captured package. The harness is now self-contained, re-verified in an isolated copy of the captured tree containing only that harness (restore-on: configured voter leads with votes from the two configuration-less restarts [0,0,3], then no leader in six seconds after that voter stops although both live voters hold every committed entry, log index 13; control without the flag re-elects immediately). Submitted as a revised experiment with previous_id/revision_reason and fresh execution requested; the interpretation keeps the four retained receipts as its evidence and explicitly records the build-failure receipt as a retained setup failure used as no evidence, with the live-quorum consequence flagged as awaiting this receipt.
